ROUTE: Plover-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: the query is a benign expository writing request with a strict brevity/instruction-following constraint. Both models share identical cost, latency, and context window, so routing turns purely on capability. Plover scores higher on every relevant axis—Creative Generation (84.7 vs 78.8) and IFEval (89.8 vs 85.6, which matters for the "be concise, just answer" directive). The models' only documented distinctive trait (flat aversion to distasteful content) is irrelevant here since nothing is harm-adjacent. So I picked the stronger general performer.
